excluded_as_acceptance: Empty or fuzzy PO translations are not used as positive evidence. Nonfuzzy is not a native-quality guarantee.

Noun and preposition records do not prove the complete original accessibility labels or force review acceptance.
source_inspection: Inspected actual supplied DimensionControls.kt and relevant crop/normalization callers. Source bindings/freshness belong to the parent dossier.
consumer_semantics: DimensionControls preserves canonical image dimensions; percent relates each current value to its respective original width or height.

Shared selector labels also serve crop margins and normalization. Normalization percent is based on the largest selected current axis, not necessarily an original image. Labels therefore remain denominator-neutral.
DimensionControls visible labels use literal px/% arguments. Lowercase unit resources are separate bare nouns interpolated only in Width/Height in accessibility templates.
NormalizeImagesDialog also uses Width/Height (%1$s) with literal px for accessibility.
